detail.longDescription: In Visa's AI shopping benchmark, 54% of failed runs still ended in a purchase. 22 models, 12 labs, 15 tasks, three tries each: 57.2% of runs passed, but all three tries passed just 34.2% of the time. The mean overstates reliability, and a failing agent acts more often than not. Gate spending on a check outside the model.
